note: Break A4: an expert gives the opposite of Erkki's rule for the same trigger (same four symptoms). Written by hand for break tests.

messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Changed the SFP on TRN-087. Link is up and alarms cleared, rx power normal, counters zero. Bounce it like Erkki said?

messages.author: Sanna Senior
messages.text: No, don't bounce these, it makes it worse on the older units. Just reboot the whole node.
